Usage: gwt path [<branch>] [flags]

Print where create would place a branch, without creating anything.

Prints the absolute path create would place the branch at, without fetching,
creating anything, or checking that the slot is free. The path follows the
configuration, so it can differ from where an existing checkout of the branch
lives; gwt list shows those.

Arguments:
  <branch>      The branch whose path to print; without it, <worktree_root>/<name of the main
                checkout>, which this repository's worktrees go under (optional).

Flags:
      --json    Print one JSON object instead of the path.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

JSON:
  One object: path, the absolute path.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed, or a creation was declined; also remove when any target failed, and merged when any
       target could not be judged, after printing every target's result
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
